name: Ernst Cassirer
shortBio: German philosopher and prominent Marburg Neo-Kantian who transformed transcendental philosophy into a universal philosophy of culture, arguing that humans construct their world through autonomous symbolic forms including language, myth, art, and science.
centralQuestion: How do symbolic forms mediate between human consciousness and reality, transforming sensory chaos into an objective world of culture?

keyWorks.title: Substance and Function
keyWorks.description: Epistemological landmark demonstrating how modern mathematical physics replaced classical Aristotelian substance concepts with relational functional concepts.

keyWorks.title: The Philosophy of Symbolic Forms
keyWorks.description: Magnum opus in three volumes systematically examining language, mythical thought, and the phenomenology of scientific knowledge as autonomous symbolic worlds.

keyWorks.title: An Essay on Man
keyWorks.description: Influential American synthesis defining human beings as 'animal symbolicum' and articulating the structural unity of human cultural life.

keyWorks.title: The Myth of the State
keyWorks.description: Posthumous political critique analyzing the resurgence of mythical thought and irrational political theology in modern 20th-century totalitarianism.
